job.question: Which pension system's investment consultant RFP requires respondents to have at least five defined benefit pension plan clients, two of which are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each?
job.expected_facts: Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), in its 2021 investment consultant services RFP (Appendix E, Minimum Qualifications Certification).
job.acceptance: OCERS/Orange County Employees Retirement System suffices. Appendix designation, year and restatement of qualification are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a SURS emerging-markets equity investment-manager RFP template, not an OCERS investment-consultant RFP. Its public-pension client criterion is preferred, uses different asset thresholds, and does not require five defined benefit pension plan clients.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL ID: RFP-##-##-## Emerging Markets Equity Issued February 14, 2022
The State Universities Retirement System (“SURS” or the “System”) is soliciting proposals

The firm has at least two existing U.S. public pension fund clients with over $1 billion in total plan assets, or at least one existing public plan as a client with over $10 billion in total plan assets.
